verdict.rationale: Pipedream's own error-handling docs say workflows can automatically retry events that yield an error, aimed at transient API failures such as outages or timeouts. The evidence does not mention backoff, per-step retry settings, retry counts or intervals, so only the core retry capability is shown. Missing for 10: documented backoff strategy, configurable retry count/interval, per-step granularity, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure automatic retries with backoff for failed steps or activities

citations.quote: You can automatically retry events that yield an error. This can help for transient errors that occur when making API requests, like when a service is down or your request times out.
You can automatically retry events that yield an error.
